notes.title: В игре была реализована система подсказок для игрока! Теперь, если игрок не може
notes.notes: The game has implemented a hint system for the player! Now, if a player cannot find an item within 1 minute, he will be asked to use a hint (at the player's request)

notes.title: The black outlines of objects have been enlarged
notes.notes:
Previously, there was a disadvantage that the items that needed to be found had a thin contour, which made them easy to find. Now the black contours of all objects have been enlarged.
Added the ability to move the camera using the keyboard arrows (WADS).
